title: The Journey That Started Something
description: I travelled all the way from Kerala to Bangalore just to prove that I could. It wasn't meant to be about love, but somehow that little ego-driven journey became the moment that set everything else in motion.

title: The Night I Told You
description: The full-night bike ride, the warmth of the night, and the moment I finally confessed my love to you.

title: Thattekad — Mini Switzerland
description: A cool morning at Thattekad. The atmosphere was calm, the grounds felt almost unreal, and we spent the morning being playful together.

title: Four Hours Close
description: Our first time cuddling. We were together for about four hours. But what stayed with me wasn't simply the closeness. My love for you was sincere. It was about you, not just the moment.

title: The First Goodbye
description: I followed your bus till Perumbavoor just to have another twenty minutes with you. When it was time for you to leave, I felt like I was breaking down from inside. But I stood there still, watching you for those last few minutes.

title: The first vist with love
description: Its been almost a month since my first visit and the first time i fell for you. It had been nearly a week from when she left to bangalore and i am here in bangalore to visit her. Some memories of the visit includes where a man asked us to get off a place while we were sitting infront of an apartment on a bench, did our first time visit to the cubbon park as a couple, had the very hot and spicy chicken fried rice at noon, fed her her chicken fried rice etc... The most important memories of the day includes the 'protein' i got in cubbon park and the time when she as usual she made me carry her things, her lip balm, college id and neck chain. Just before my comeback i searched through all my pockets and returned her college id and lip balm that we both forgot. However her neckchain stayed inside my shirts pocket. I only realised it when i reached the Kodegehalli Gate bus stop. All day long while crossing busy roads, she held my hand and pulled me across the road just like how she would treat her little brother or son. This action made me fall for her the entire day. But with a little grief and joy i left back to Home.

title: Following till Angamaly
description: It was the day of her return. The first time i came along with her amma to say goodbye. However just saying goodbye from muvattupuzha was my plan, i followed her hoping that the bus would stop near perumbavoor. But surprisingly it travelled all through perumbavoor and reached the Indian Oil Swagath petrol Pump in Angamaly. Spent some time there having icecream and teasing each other. Had a small fight regarding Kevin. The vibrant memory about the event is when a group of school girls called out saying "couples corner" from their bus. Got a warm hug before leaving. Another interesting thing about the travel was when i reached back at pandappilly by 11:30 PM, the bike travelled about 99 kilometers.

title: The 2 day stay
description:
It was 10th of October Saturday, it was my third time in bangalore to see her. I waited at the hospital till about 10:50 AM till she finishes her exam. Got out of aster, walked to 'Theertha' to have a Biriyani. I loved it when she said she necessarily didn't had hunger to eat them, but she forced me to eat only because she wanted me to eat something. We arrived at theertha and they informed that the food will only be ready by 1:30 so we went upstairs had an icecream. It was then a group of her friends came there to have something. I was so scared but I stayed calm outside. Even one of her friend asked my name and asked whether i had come to kerala just to meet her. I replied it with an awkward smile. After the ice cream we again went downstairs and waited till 1:30 to have the Biriyani. And meanwhile the chechi in the restaurant checked us once in a while with a gentle smile. We had our food and went to the Sahakara Nagara Park and spent our time sharing our musics. Then we later went to the Vishal Mega Mart, broke a bag kept there, purchased 2 packets of Sonam Papadi and Dairy Milk. Then we went to the Park near Periyar Cafe and later on dropped her infront of her hostel. The most interesting part of the journey happened next. After she had her dinner, by 9pm i asked her whether i could charge my phone inside her hostel. So i gave her my phone and we talked while talked till 12 at midnight. She was inside her hostel and i was outside where a iron grill seperated us. However just before she left i got some 'protein' through the iron bars and my phone charged. Later i went to on to have a horrific night among barking Dogs and tough mosquitoes where i really got into the real life of Bengaluru. Later on i woked up around 3.30am and was excited very much to go out with her in the early morning. I jumped and stretched all along the street out of excitement. Since her hostel gate was not yet opened she came out by 5.45am. During the waiting period she gave me my bag and i changed my clothes infront of her hostel. And the fun part is i was just infront of the hostels security camera. So she came out and we walked towards aster, had my brushing and other activities and had a good coffee. Then she insisted that we go to Madiwala to have our breakfast from a Kerala Restaurant. We took buses to Madiwala. Reached there and had an Appam and a Chicken Stew. It was nice and she really liked it. Later we can back to cubbon park and wandered all around the park to find a peaceful place. Later on we sat somewhere where we spend time. When it was time to leave, i got a stomach ache and she had terrible headachd and leg pain. So she was at her extreme anger thinking that i actually doesn't mind her. But it was actually my stomach ache that made me treat her less. Then we came back to Theertha to have Biriyani. As by the day, everyone of the restaurant recognized us. After the biriyani we became the earlier vibrant versions of ourselves. We then visited the Sahakara Nagara Park where we sat on a bench and she shared all her family stories with her. While she was telling about her mother, her eyes went wet and tears flowed down through her cheeks. I held her tight as she cried and helped to calm her down. It was the most warm feeling of the entire day as it made me feel like i became a man infront of whom she can really openup things and cry without getting the feeling of being judged. Such emotions and thoughts made me fall for her even more. While leaving the  Sahakara Nagara Park we bought a cotton candy and she fed me it on the way back to her hostel. We then roamed through the roadways and she scolded me enough for not having food. Later i dropped her in her hostel, she gave me a warm kiss on my hand and i walked back to Kodegehalli gate to return by 8:30Pm. On the walk, all the two day memories scrolled through my mind as i was not in a rush to catch bus. Since this time i had plenty of time left for the train.
